posts.title: Two Vape Store Muslims Arrested After Ole Miss Drug Deaths

link_metadata.description: Two University of Mississippi students were found dead earlier this week with packaged kratom discovered at both scenes. Now, authorities have arrested two men and seized hundreds of units of kratom and other suspected narcotics from an Oxford business allegedly selling illegal substances.The Lafayette County Metro Narcotics Unit executed a search warrant Thursday at Puffs Vape, Tobacco and Beer Store on Heritage Drive after investigators conducted a controlled purchase of illegal substances from the business, according to a Friday news release.Authorities said they recovered more than 500 units of kratom, along with THC cartridges, gummies, and other suspected narcotics. Yahya Mohamed Mosleh, 51, and Islam Mohamed, 18, both living in Oxford, were arrested and charged with possession of Schedule I controlled substances with intent to distribute.
